columns.title: Дата
columns.meaning: Date of principle/belief recording; do not backfill old rows without a known date.

columns.title: Пример
columns.meaning: Illustrative scenario; does not establish performed action.

columns.title: ID принципа
columns.meaning: Stable identifier for new principles and journal links; old rows may remain empty.

application: Only to the named owner's accounting and the principle's explicit scope; missing details do not block raw intake.
write_policy: Explicit instruction by the owner or authorized representative; ordinary Work only reads.

feedback_policy.numbering: 1-based ordinal among the named owner's nonempty principles in current sheet order; include exact text and private row range.
feedback_policy.delivery: Show to the person through the receiving Work in an authorized private conversation; without transport mark prepared, not delivered.
feedback_policy.raw_input: Always preserve and accept; do not invent missing details.
feedback_policy.completion: Unresolved required clarification prevents final processing completion.

compatibility: A:B remain unchanged; append C:G and preserve all old rows. Date is a numeric Sheets date. Unknown historic dates and IDs remain blank.

columns.title: Дата
columns.meaning: Date recorded, not an inferred event date.

practice_journal.write_policy: Explicit instruction by the owner. Add further examples as separate linked rows; do not replace earlier examples. Applied requires an actual reported action; conscious=yes requires explicit owner confirmation of awareness in that action. Reflection is not payment or application. Unknown event dates and results stay unknown; preserve original source.
practice_journal.automation: Manual protocol only; no background detection, scheduling, or automatic writes are implied.

belief_policy: A belief is the owner's stated personal attitude, not verification of cash balance or a guarantee of future income. Preserve literal input separately; do not infer financial transactions from a belief or example.
